newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - August 28.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - August 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones rose by 17.38 points to 5,711.27. PLDT's ADR fell by $ 1/4 to $58 7/8.
* The peso closed at 26.195 to a U.S.dollar from 26.209.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,196.39, down 13.91.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate dropped to 10.90625 percent from 11.71875.
